name: Knowledge Prompt Chaining for Semantic Modeling
executive_summary: Chain prompts specifically to extract structured semantic models (entities, relations, schema) from unstructured text.
description: Applies the general prompt-chaining pattern to the specific problem of pulling a structured semantic model out of free text: one stage extracts candidate entities/relations, a later stage validates and assembles them into a consistent schema. A domain-specific application of chaining rather than a new chaining mechanism.
when_to_use: Extracting structured knowledge graphs, entity-relation sets, or schemas from unstructured source text.
when_not_to_use: The target output isn't a structured semantic model — this is a narrow, domain-specific application.
known_pitfalls: Errors in early extraction stages propagate into the final assembled schema, same failure shape as any sequential chain.

primary_source.title: Knowledge Prompt Chaining for Semantic Modeling
